$comment: Vectorization profiles for the regulatory_docs agent. A profile defines how a SELECTED document is chunked, embedded, and stored in a Qdrant cluster. Pick one via payload.profile (defaults to 'default_profile' below). Secrets (QDRANT_URL/QDRANT_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY) live in .env — never here. Swapping the embedding model or target collection is a config edit, not a code change. embedding.provider: 'openai' (real, needs the llm extra + key) or 'hash' (deterministic local, no deps/keys — for dev/tests only). qdrant.cluster: 'main'/'kg' connect to the cloud cluster using QDRANT_URL/QDRANT_API_KEY (and QDRANT_URL_KG/QDRANT_API_KEY_KG for 'kg') read from .env; 'memory' uses qdrant-client's in-process mode. Override the file location with the VECTORIZATION_CONFIG env var.

default.description: OpenAI small embeddings into the main Qdrant cluster (cosine).

openai-large.description: Higher-fidelity OpenAI large embeddings (3072-d) into the main cluster.

offline.description: Deterministic local hash embedder into an in-process Qdrant — no keys/network. Dev/tests only; not semantically meaningful.
